# How much can you convert to a Roth this year before the tax jumps?

> Free 2026 Roth conversion calculator: see exactly how much to convert to fill the 12%, 22% or 24% bracket, the tax it costs, the 65+ senior-deduction phase-out and the Medicare IRMAA cliff. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
